<!-- pr-reviewer: 7e8d92cff09efce1170b6e0af054f6920f01288c -->
**Needs changes before merge** (high-tier review: rapid-in-stock law, safety floor). The lateral reading itself is sound; the PR is stale against its parent #1098 and would under-read once re-stacked.

Reviewed as stacked on #1098: only commit 7e8d92cf (stock_top.rs, stock_top_tests.rs, stepped_stock_link.rs, one decision file) is judged here.

**What looks good**
- Lateral rapid over raised stock is convicted when it should be: each band is read over the capsule the move sweeps (`dist2_seg_tri`, stock_top.rs ~L126), so a boss under the centre line, under the rim (`a_boss_under_the_rim_along_the_way_stands`), or under the holder band keeps the conviction, as does a climbing crossing.
- Under-reading guard: the tip is taken at the lower end for the whole move (`low = from.z.min(to.z)`), so a climbing/falling traverse can only over-report. Stock top is the highest vertex of any facet whose plan comes within reach (conservative, same bound as the dive).
- No earlier conviction is lost: it only `retain`s away convictions; posed rapids, non-rapids, vertical retracts, radial/revolve/rotary, open/non-manifold/empty shells, non-finite z_tol/ends, and a flute capsule that meets no facet all keep the conviction. A zero-length capsule reads `dist2_tri` exactly, so dive verdicts are unchanged. The one changed #1098 pin is explained and matches the new design.
- Degenerate input: non-finite ends return true (conviction kept); empty/non-closed shells refused by name in `closed_shell`. No unwrap/expect/panic in the touched source. Files under 400 lines, provenance line present, no snapshot PNGs, no process files, no deps/build.rs/.github.

**Local results** (worktree, trial-merged with upstream/main aca634f6 cleanly; own target/, sccache)
| check | result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-sim` (all binaries incl. 17 stock_top tests) | pass |
| app `stepped_stock_link` / `stepped_stock_rapid` / `ladder_entry_height` | 3 / 4 / 4 pass |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |
Not run: the full batch gate (author reports it green); app lib tests (known-red per #1146).

**Requested before merge**
1. The PR's base is out of date. #1098 has moved from 6440858b (this branch's base, as the quick-pass comment states) to 38ea8cf4, "the stock-top re-reading reads the widest stack band and the model excess". Merging 38ea8cf4 into this head conflicts in `crates/sim/src/verify/stock_top.rs` (acquit_by_stock_top / bands). Please merge #1098's current head (or main once #1098 lands) and resolve it.
2. In that resolution the lateral path must take the new rules, or it under-reads where the dive does not: `low - e` for the tip (stock_top.rs lateral branch, currently `low` unadjusted), band radii grown by `e` and the widest-of-holder/shank above the shank (via the new `bands(tool, e)`), and `excess` non-finite keeps the conviction. A coarse model standing `e` outside its facets could otherwise be acquitted on a traverse by less than `e`. Add a pin: a traverse that clears the meshed boss by less than the excess stays convicted.
3. The "Not exercised" note says tilted-frame setups are untested for lateral rapids; fine to leave, but then say in the decision file that lateral re-reading is upright-only by construction (it is: posed rapids keep the conviction).

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- Stock-sourced ops (no judged stock solid) are still not re-read, by #1098's design; agreed this PR need not change that.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: ca791ed27706f7a7e2fcd39386349eeffca16c51 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** Both blockers from the 7e8d92cf review are fixed. This head is judged fresh at the high tier (rapid-into-stock verify, safety floor).

#1098 has merged (0fc30b65), so this is no longer stacked. The delta against upstream main is this PR's own four files.

**Blockers re-checked**
1. Stale base: fixed. Main is merged in and a trial merge with current upstream main is "Already up to date" with no conflicts.
2. Excess rules: fixed. The lateral branch calls `clear_of(solids, (a, b), low - e, &bands, z_tol)` (`crates/sim/src/verify/stock_top.rs`, lateral branch of `acquit_by_stock_top`). It uses the same `bands(tool, e)` as the dive, so radii grow by `e`, and the non-finite-excess refusal applies to both paths. I mutated the tip back to `low`, and `a_traverse_takes_the_coarse_models_excess_like_a_dive` then fails, so the pin is real. It covers a link 0.3 mm over the meshed step and a rim 0.3 mm short of the boss, both clear at excess 0 and convicted at 0.5.
3. Non-blocking note: the decision file now states the lateral re-reading is upright-only.

**Safety read of the new code (it must never under-read)**
- The capsule bound holds. `dist2_seg_tri` is 0 when a segment meets the triangle, since a crossing is caught by `dist2_segs` on the edges and a touching or contained end by `dist2_tri` of the ends. Otherwise it is the least end-to-triangle or segment-to-edge distance. A degenerate (vertical) facet is read as its edges. It over-reports for slopes and never hides a facet.
- The tip is at `low - e` for the whole move, so a climbing or falling traverse is judged lower than it is. That can only over-report.
- It fails closed: it keeps the conviction for a non-finite end, a non-finite `low`, a posed rapid, an open or non-manifold shell, a column-free mode, or a flute capsule that meets no facet. It only removes convictions and never adds one.
- A point segment reads `dist2_tri` of the point, so every dive verdict is unchanged. The dive guard now also requires a finite `from.z`, which is stricter.
- The earlier convictions survive: #1098's `stepped_stock_rapid` and `ladder_entry_height` suites are green. The one changed pin, `only_upright_column_dives_are_re_read`, is explained in the body and decision file, and the same move posed stays convicted.

**Local results (head merged with upstream main, own worktree, sccache)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-sim` | all green (92 lib incl. 19 `stock_top`, plus every sim suite) |
| `camcraft-app` `stepped_stock_link` | 3 passed |
| `camcraft-app` `stepped_stock_rapid` | 8 passed |
| `camcraft-app` `ladder_entry_height` | 4 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Law check**
- No unwrap, expect or panic added. No dependency, build.rs, `.github`, script or process file change, so no `PROCESS_VERSION` bump is needed.
- No snapshot PNG or golden touched. The body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #1095`. There is no CHANGELOG.md edit, and the decision record is in `docs/decisions/`.
- `stock_top.rs` is 182 lines and the tests are split into their own file.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- No test pins an upright rapid in a tilted plane's local frame. The PR body says so, and the posed case stays convicted.
- A stock-sourced op with no judged stock solid is not re-read. That is #1098's design and is stated in the PR.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
